# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 (Wave 2) Package 1: Byzantine Renaissance 3-Way Intellectual Debate (oe_ren_). Generated by gen_byz_renaissance.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Byzantine Renaissance 3-Way Intellectual Debate triggers (oe_ren_).

# Matches non-rebel Byzantium or restored Rome.
oe_ren_is_empire = {
    OR = {
        AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
        AND = { tag = ROM is_rebel_country = no }
    }
}

# True while the Renaissance debate arc is active (read-only interface for SIT-2).
oe_ren_is_active = {
    has_variable = oe_ren_active
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_done }
}

# Calm enough for discretionary intellectual debate events.
oe_ren_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
}

# Holds Constantinople directly.
oe_ren_holds_city = {
    location:constantinople = { owner ?= root }
}

# Imperial bloc (BYZ/ROM or subjects) holds Mystras.
oe_ren_bloc_holds_mystras = {
    location:mystras = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
}

# Strong enough to retain / recall Greek scholars (either strong-route tier >= 2 or stable & prosperous in City).
oe_ren_can_retain_scholars = {
    oe_ren_holds_city = yes
    OR = {
        oe_sr_strong = yes
        AND = { stability >= 15 gold >= 180 }
    }
}

# Minimum spacing between automatic events (18 months since last oe_ren event).
oe_ren_pace_ready = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_next_m }
        AND = { has_variable = oe_ren_next_m oe_ml_month_now >= var:oe_ren_next_m }
    }
}

# Triumphant culmination gate: ideological tension below 80 and stability non-negative.
oe_ren_triumph_ok = {
    stability >= 0
    OR = {
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_tension }
        AND = { has_variable = oe_ren_tension var:oe_ren_tension < 80 }
    }
}

# School influence leadership helpers (used by AI weights, decisions, and SIT-2).
oe_ren_hes_leading = {
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hes
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_neo
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hum
    trigger_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hes
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_neo
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hum
        }
        var:oe_ren_inf_hes >= var:oe_ren_inf_neo
        var:oe_ren_inf_hes >= var:oe_ren_inf_hum
    }
}
oe_ren_neo_leading = {
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hes
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_neo
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hum
    trigger_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hes
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_neo
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hum
        }
        var:oe_ren_inf_neo >= var:oe_ren_inf_hes
        var:oe_ren_inf_neo >= var:oe_ren_inf_hum
    }
}
oe_ren_hum_leading = {
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hes
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_neo
    has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hum
    trigger_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hes
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_neo
            has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hum
        }
        var:oe_ren_inf_hum >= var:oe_ren_inf_hes
        var:oe_ren_inf_hum >= var:oe_ren_inf_neo
    }
}

# Culmination event gate: at least 10 years after the Great Debate or from 1495 onwards.
oe_ren_culm_ready = {
    has_variable = oe_ren_ev9_done
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_culm_done }
    OR = {
        current_date >= 1495.1.1
        AND = { has_variable = oe_ren_culm_m oe_ml_month_now >= var:oe_ren_culm_m }
    }
}
